item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when is those eight ids green with every failure a test-side correction of a superseded expectation, and it holds: git show 63f40039:reckon/crew/recovery.py digests equal to base ac7e9e50, so no executable change carries a correction, and my own rerun of the eight ids from the reviewed tree logs 8 passed.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal asked the eight superseded watch-suite ids to move onto the promoted-departure rule, the retired FOREIGN_OWNER glyph, the typed recovery classification and the oneshot unit inventory; all four groups land in the four named test files and the eight ids pass at head 63f40039.
item_verdicts.manifest: the manifest names the same six changed_paths, all four log receipts, the declared mutation with its revert note for recovery.py, and one follow_on outside the fence; its tests field describes the eight-id run without naming the eight ids.
item_verdicts.write_paths: all six changed files sit inside the declared fence; the two docs files are pure insertions (88 and 37 added lines) and every plan-* meta line in docs/plans/a-crew-process-ends-with-its-owner.html is untouched.

justifications.durability: the tests pin behaviour already in place in production rather than changing it, the fixture writes its ledger row through the producer's own path function so a producer rename fails the fixture instead of passing silently, and the one residual drift, the retired FOREIGN_OWNER reference at tests/test_crew_session_delivery.py:214, is reported as a follow_on rather than repaired because it lies outside the fence.
justifications.evidence: every receipt reproduces — logs/gate.log 24 passed, logs/compare-four.log 119 passed, logs/negative-control.log repeats the declared string and fails its named test, and my rerun of the eight ids pins the recovery module to the reviewed tree — but the eight-id receipt at logs/named-eight.log:1 does not name its eight ids (FINDING below).
justifications.fit: the changes hold the conventions of the files they land in — the new helper sits beside the pointer fixtures that call it, the oneshot case mirrors RESTART_POLICY_UNITS at tests/test_watcher_unit_restart.py:33 with its own Type=oneshot case at :94, and the catch-all inventory test keeps every unit template in the tree covered.
justifications.goal_fidelity: all four groups are addressed as the goal states, including the goal's own concession that a departure recorded as promoted must read promoted, which the fixture supplies through the producer's own ledger row path (reckon/ledger.py:641) at tests/test_crew_watch_lifetime.py:22 rather than through a code change.
justifications.scope_discipline: the six changed files are exactly the declared fence, the four comparison files carry no diff at head, and docs/plans/a-crew-process-ends-with-its-owner.html gains its 37 lines by insertion only with every peer evidence row and plan-* meta line intact.
